methods_quotes.q: State-specific data were aggregated and weighted to reflect age, sex, and racial/ethnic distribution, and chi-square tests were used to test all univariate associations.

The models then were used to calculate adjusted percentages using the distributions of female respondents aged > 25 years in the total population.
All analyses were conducted using SASv8 software with SUDAAN to estimate standard errors.
